items.text: Ku vya Mowabu. Uku ni k’Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo agize, ni we Mana y’Abisirayeli: at’ I Nebo habonye ibara! Kuko hakomvomvowe: i Kiriyatayimu haratēterewe, haratsinzwe: i Misigabu haratēterewe, harasanganguwe.
Icubahiro c’i Mowabu kiraheze; bahahigiye imihigo bar’ i Heshiboni, bat’ Enda ni muze tuhageseze, ntihabe hakiba ihanga. Nawe Madumeni, uzozibizwa; inkota izogukurikirana.
Ijwi ry’amaborogo rituruka i Horonayimu: har’ ukunyaga n’ ugutikiza gukomeye.
I Mowabu haratikiye; abana baho bumvikanisha urwānāga.
Kuko bazodūga ku kadūgo k’i Luhiti barira ingenda badahengeshanya; ku kamanuko k’i Horonayimu bumvise umunihiro w’umuborogo w’ abagesezwa.
Yer 17:6
Muhunge, mwunzūre amagara, mube nk’agasaka k’inkōkōre mu bugaragwa.
1 Abam 11:7
Yes 46:2
Yer 49:3
Ko wishimiye ibikorwa vyawe n’ubutunzi bgawe, nawe nyene uzotsindwa: kand’ ikigirwamana Kemoshi kizojanwa ar’ inyagano, bo n’abaherezi baco n’abaganwa baco.
Yos 13:9
Kand’ umunyazi azoshika ku gisagara cose, nta gisagara na kimwe kizomukira: ababa mu mwonga bazohona, n’ababa mu kiyaya bazogesezwa, nk’uk’ Uhoraho yabivuze.
Muhe Mowabu amababa, kugira ngo haguruke hīgīre: ibisagara vyaho bizocika amatongo, ata wukiriho wo kuhaba.
1 Abam 20:42
Aravumwe uwanjanjwa ku gikorwa c’Uhoraho; aravumwe ūbuza inkota yiwe kuvisha amaraso.
Zef 1:12

Mowabu hamye hidibamiye uhereye mu buto bgaho, hireretse ku mvūzo, ntihāsukanuwe ngo have mu mubindi haje mu wundi, ntihājanywe kw inyagano; ni co gituma uburyohe bgaho bukiri muri ho, n’ubumote bgaho ntibutītūke.
Nuko rāba, imisi igira ize, ni k’Uhoraho agize, nzoharungikira abacuranguza, bazohacuranguza, barangūze imibindi yaho, bamenagure amakarabo yaho.
1 Abam 12:29
Hos 10:6
Abanyamowabu bazomāramāzwa na Kemoshi, nk’ ukw ab’ inzu ya Isirayeli bāmāramājwe n’ivy’ i Beteli bāri bishimiye.
Muvuga ngw iki ngo Mur’ abahizi, kandi ngo Mur’ intōre zo kuja mu ntambara?
Mowabu hacitse imisaka, badūze gutera ibisagara vyaho, kand’ imisore yaho y’intōre imanutse gukekagurwa, ni k’Umwami agize, yitwa Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo.
Ukugesezwa kw’i Mowabu kuri hafi gushika, ivyago vyaho bije akabushungwe.
Yes 9:4
Mwebge abahakikije mwese muharirire, namwe mwese abazi izina ryaho, muvuge, mut’ Es’ ukuntu ubuhiri bukomeye buvunitse, ya nkoni ishajije!
Yes 47:1
Yewe wa mukobga uba i Diboni, manuka uve mu cubahiro cawe, wicare ahagadutse; kuk’ umunyazi w’i Mowabu adūze kukurwanya, yasanganguye ibihome vyawe bikomeye.
Ewe uba i Aroweri, hagarara i ruhande y’ inzira, wirābire indore: baza umugabo ahunze n’umugore yiyunzūra, uti Bibaye bite?
Mowabu haratēterewe; kuko hasanganguwe; muboroge, murire; muvuge inkuru kuri Arunoni kw i Mowabu hageseye.
Iteka haciriweko rishitse mu ntāra yo hasi mu kiyaya, no kuri Holoni, no kuri Yahaza, no kuri Mefata,
no kuri Diboni, no kuri Nebo, no kuri Beti‐dibulatayimu,
no kuri Kiriyatayimu, no kuri Beti‐gamuli, no kuri Beti‐meyoni,
Am 2:2
no kuri Keriyoti, no kuri Bosira, no ku bisagara vyose vyo mu gihugu c’i Mowabu, ibiri kure n’ibiri hafi.
Ihembe ry’i Mowabu rirakondowe, n’ukuboko kwaho kuravunitse, ni k’Uhoraho agize.
Muhaboreze, kuko hinantaje k’ Uhoraho; nuko Mowabu hazokwivurunga mu bidashwe vyaho, hacike agatwengo.
Zab 64:8
Int 2:15
Ezk 25:8
Zef 2:8
None Isirayeli ntiwamugize agatwengo? Mbega yabonetsek’ ubusuma? Kuk’ uk’ umuvuga kwose uzunza umutwe.
Zab 55:6
Yemwe ababa i Mowabu, ni muve mu bisagara, muje kuba mu masenga; mube nk’ inuma yārika icāri cayo mu mbavu z’umuryango w’isenga.
Twumvise ivy’ ubgibone bg’i Mowabu, yuko hafise ubgibone bginshi; ivy’ ukwishira hejuru kwaho, n’ivy’ ubgibone bgaho, n’ivy’ amanyama yaho, n’ivy’ ukwigira hanini kwo mu mutima waho.
Nzi uburake bgaho, ni k’Uhoraho agize, yukw ata co bumaze; ukwihayagiza kwaho nta co kwakoze.
2 Abam 3:25
Ni co kizotuma mborogera Mowabu; mbere nzotakira i Mowabu hose: bazovugiriza amarūru abagabo b’i Kiri‐heresi.
Ewe ruzabibu rw’ i Sibuma, nzokuririra kurusha kurira kw’i Yazeri; amashami yawe aca hejuru y’ikiyaga, agashika no ku kiyaga c’i Yazeri: umunyazi afashe ku vyo weze no ku vyo wimbuweko vya vino.

Umunezero n’uguhimbarwa bikūweho, bikūwe mu ndimiro imera no mu gihugu c’i Mowabu; natumye vino ibura mu mato akanyirwamwo: nta wuzoganisha ibirenge n’akāmo k’umunezero: akāmo kazobaho kazoba ar’ ak’ intambara, ntikazoba ar’ ak’ umunezero.

Gutaka kw’i Heshiboni kwumvikana gushitsa n’i Eleyale; mber’ amajwi yabo ashika n’i Yahazi, kand’ ahēra i Sowari agashitsa n’i Horonayimu bo n’i Egilati‐shelishiya: kuko n’amazi y’i Nimurimu azocika iyondoyondo.
Ikigeretseko nzoherengeteza i Mowabu ūtangira ikimazi mu gitabo, n’uwosereza imibavu imana ziwe, ni k’Uhoraho agize.
Ni co gitumye Mowabu umutima wanje uhacurira intimba mu mwironge, abagabo b’i Kiri‐heresi ubacurira intimba mu mwironge: kukw ivy’ ibitayega hāronse bihonnye.
Yer 47:5
Int 2:10
Kukw imitwe yabo yose imowe inkomvorera, n’ ubganwa bgose bumowe; ku maboko yose har’ ibikebagure, no mu rukenyerero hose hakenyeye amagunira.
Hejuru ku nzu zose z’i Mowabu no mu nzira zaho, hose hose har’ amaborogo: kuko nasābije Mowabu nk’urujo rudashimwa, ni k’Uhoraho agize.
Ewe kuntu hasābijwe! Ewe kuntu baboroga! Ewe kuntu ab’ i Mowabu baroye irya bomotse batēterewe! Uko ni ko Mowabu hazohinduka agatwengo n’akumiza ku bahakikije bose.
Yes 8:8
Ezk 17:3
Kuk’ ukw ari k’Uhoraho agize, at’ Eh’ umwansi azoza aguruka nk’inkukuma,
inkukuma ni yo mpungu.
azosanza amababa i Mowabu.
I Keriyoti haratsinzwe, ibihome bineshejwe giturumbuka; kur’ uwo musi imitima y’abahizi b’i Mowabu izomera nk’umutima w’ umugore ari mu bise.
Yes 7:8
Kandi Mowabu hazogesezwa ngo ntihabe hakiba ihanga, kuko hinantaje k’Uhoraho.
Int 3:47
Wewe uba i Mowabu, ibiteye ubgoba n’urusumanyenzi n’umutego bigushitseko, ni k’Uhoraho agize.
Ūhunga ibiteye ubgoba azogwa mu rusumanyenzi; uwūrira ngw ave mu rusumanyenzi umutego uzomufata: kukw i Mowabu nzohashitsako umwaka wo kūzirwa kwabo, ni k’Uhoraho agize.
Abāhunze basigaye ata nkomezi mu gitūtu c’i Heshiboni: arik’ umuriro uturutse i Heshiboni, urubeya ruturutse hagati y’i Sihoni, rutongoye impande z’i Mowabu, n’igitwariro c’abanyamuvurungano.
Ubonye ibara, Mowabu! Abantu ba Kemoshi baragowe! Kukw abahungu bawe bajanywe ar’ inyagano, n’abakobga bawe mu ngoyi.
Yamara nzotuma ab’i Mowabu bahindukira bave mu kinyago mu misi yo hanyuma, ni k’Uhoraho agize. Ivy’ iteka Mowabu haciriwe bigarukiye aho.
